book.name: Aposel
book.title: Aposel tal ol wangwo ha bol engwi

content: Pol Molta malgi mongwo ha
Ena na yalhobi ere mena ure momingere, ganba i Molta ganba dimua dungwo pimingi.
Pimingere ganba hong yalhobi na yalhobi ol wai ol na tomia wai pir tomingi. Tomingere nimin yare hair omia er sulu gale na aule ire ongure endo pir momingi.
Momingere Pol er nobilang tau oun bolo i ure galala dire omba, onba ta er sina ala i mole endo dere ure Pol aling kul hangwi.
Hamia hanere, “Ayo, yal i ari si gongwo yal momia, nir bani aidole mena umba, omaga gonamia han molo,” dungwi.
Dimba, Pol aling pera sungure onba ya endo ala sire de gongwi. Gongure Pol gaung bani ogolo ta sikima.

Ena yalhobi Pol kwi han mole, gonam mo, gaun bani yaunam mo, omeling malangwo yanam mo, dire kwi han mongwi. Mol gobari pire hamba, gaung bani tal ta olkimia, arihobi hanere nomani miki sire, “Ayo, yal i ari monangwo gaung tal ta olkimia, kwia momue,” dungwi.
Dungure ganba mongwo ganba i singaba Pablias ya nongwo dimia, yal i ure na aule ire malgi pire pana gal na tongwi. Tongure hamen haung sui tai dire Pablias kina momingi.
Momingere Pablias irang algi yo bilere, gaung nega dimia pai mongwi. Mongure Pol pi mala pire God ha ditere aling gaung bani angure, nibil i gintani wai sungure ya mongwi.
Yu ongwo i hanere oo malgi ari nu nibil pangwo hobi aule ire u Pol mongwo bani ungure awai ol tongwi.
Tongure yalhobi na gina wai pire talhan miki weni na tongwi. Tongure sipi ala pire ere namna dire ominga haung i homena ya, gal kul ya, talhan tau wa duminga tali na tongwi.
Pol Rom malgi pi pa dungwo ha
Ena haba sui tai dire Molta ganba pai molere, Aleksandria aidole ungwo sipi ta hang Kwia Sutani wa dungwo sipi hamen hair ungwo haung si gol emia, kina ereho momingere, ere nala di ongure omingi.
Pire pi Sairakyus malgi pa dire hamen haung sui tai dire pai molere ere omingi.
Pire pi Risiam malgi pa dimingi. Pa dire momingere boma hamen hair ungure ominga ominga, hamen haung sutani wai sungure, Piutiolai malgi pa dimingi.
Pa dire hamingere, Yisas pir tongwo ari tau momia hanere, sare taniga yalhobi kina pana gal momingi.

Mole aidole ere pi Rom malgi pa dimingi. Pa dire mena momingere, Yisas pir tongwo hobi na gina umua dungwo pungwi. Pire pi Apias maket e nongwo bani ure Stua Sui Tai Dire dungwo ganba bani ure na hangwi. Hangure Pol Yisas pir tongwo hobi hanere, God maa e tere gumang nimni mole mongwi.
Ena na gina Rom malgi omingere gabman Pol wi dungwo i oo ta to. Tengere soldia ta kene ol monamua dungure tongwi.
Pol Rom malgi ha maing di tibi olungwo ha

Ena hamen haung sui tai dire wai sungure, Pol Rom malgi Yuda ari singaba mongwo hobi wo dungwi. Dimia ungure Pol yu ditongwi, “Yalhobo, na Yuda arihobi, te nan kwiana moya krehaman ha di na tongwo irai ta isusu olekia. Olekiba, Yerusalem malgi Yuda ari hobi na han sire Roman soldia hobi na tomua.
Na tongure ha hol olere, ‘gonanga ha ta oun dekimia, ere mena nanua’ di na tomua.

Tomba, Yuda ari hobi yulang bole dagi dungure, na aidole mena nalga paikimia dire, singaba Sisa mongwo bani ugere ha hol i ol na tenama dire wiwa. Wiiba, nan gamna hobi ha di mere si teralga ha ta paikimia.

Na ha i mone di tibi ol ni terala dire ni yalhobi gala diga ungere di ni teiwa. Na ana bani aiyulang han dimia hano. Nan Isrel ari hobi yal ta unangwo pi tege enaminua dire kwi mominga yal i, tani pire ana bani han simia hano.”

Dungure Yuda ari Rom ke pangwo hobi yu ditongwi, “Yudia yalhobi pasi haya bol na tenangwo hanere ha di ni tenaminba, Yudia yal ta na mominga baniya ure ha wai ol na tenangwo pirikiminua. Te ni digan monua dinangwo pirikiminua.
Pirikiminba, ari ganba bina holo holo mongwo hobi ni gamnahobi ni a ime ol ni tongwo piminua. Pire ni nin maing nomani si pinanga unangwo meri dinanga pinaminua,” dungwi.

Ena Pol yalhobi kina ha dirala dire haung ta ba engwi. Haung ba engwo gin i ari hobi miki weni Pol mongwo bani u ku bongwi. U ku bongure Pol honmil kebering hole God kene ongwo hol i, ha di tibi ol te mongwo mongwo hamen girungwi. Di te mongwo ha iwe, Moses Lo krehaman ha ire, God hana togu yalhobi ha di engwo i ire dire, yal ta unamua dungwo yal irai, Yisas haya uma dungwo piminua dire, wara wara kere ditongwi.
Tomia, tau pir tomba, tau nomani si ala mala ole pir tekima.
Tekire nin di wama tere bolbin dire ere ongwi. Hongebe Pol ha ta kebering holala dire yu dungwi, “Ayo, God Kwiang kwiana moya hana togu yal Aisaia yong wu bilere, ha i grang bani engure yu dimia,

God mole yu dimia, Ni ari mongwo bani pire yu dito. Ha pir pir ole monanba, memini pir po sikinanua. Omen han han ole monanba, ere ogolo han po sikinanua. Ari yal al hobi nomani wai paikinangure, ha i pinangwo ha pirikire isime ere monamua.
Te omeling hanangwo ha pirikire ereyu isime ere monamua. Yu molkinangwo ha maing pir po sire, han po sire, iina dire, sigare kule, na molga bani unangwo aki di teralba.” Ais 6:9-10

Ha di engwo i kere wai sire, Pol ainere yu ditongwi, “Ha maing iwe, God aki dinangure, sigare kule u wai nanga ha pirikinia. God na nu sinangwo ere wiyol para weni kepangwo hona hona i pire, ha i boling kul teralga pinangwo pamua.”
(Di te wai sungure, Yuda ari hobi nin ha bolbin di wama tere ere ongwi.)
Ena me erin sutani Pol nin oo bring sire pangwo ala i molere, ari tau yal i mongwo bani ungure, kina ha wai ole pana wai gale mongwi.
Mole God kene ongwo hol i ha ire, Yulang Hong Yisas Kraist ol wai ol na tongwo maing ire dire, nimni mole arihobi nir si tongwi. Te mongure yal ta hobang si tekima. Para.
